runs.task:
PERSONA: Elena Park — Founder / Head of Product at Early-stage consumer startup evaluating vendors this week.
Context: Pick a platform she can demo to investors in 48 hours. You care about: time-to-first-agent, pricing clarity, onboarding, knowledge upload, numbers.
PLATFORM: Bland AI product console (you are already signed in).
USER GOAL: Find knowledge base, documents, or FAQ upload for grounding the agent.
SUCCESS: Knowledge/docs UI found OR documented absent.
Nav hint (optional): Knowledge / Memory / Documents if present.
Rules: Do not create/delete API keys, do not place live phone calls, do not change billing. Explore read-only. When done, in your final answer include: (1) what you accomplished, (2) 2–4 things you LIKED about Bland AI's UX for this goal, (3) 2–4 things you DISLIKED or found confusing, (4) how hard this felt (easy/medium/hard).
runs.judge_reason: The agent successfully navigated to the Bland AI dashboard as instructed. It then correctly identified and clicked on the 'Knowledge base' section in the sidebar. Following this, it clicked on '+ Add sources', which opened a modal clearly showing options to upload files (PDF, TXT, CSV, JSON, DOCX), add website links, input text, or use integrations. This directly addresses the user's goal of finding knowledge base, documents, or FAQ upload for grounding the agent.
runs.judge_evidence: The final URL is https://app.bland.ai/dashboard/knowledge-base, which is the knowledge base page. The action summary shows that the agent clicked on "+ Add sources" which would lead to the UI for uploading knowledge.
